# Nikodem Boryczka — AI Developer & Software Engineer

## Who am I?
Nikodem Boryczka is an AI Developer and Software Engineer from Silesia, Poland. He is a student at Programming Technical School with AI specialization. He builds open-source tools, web applications, and explores software engineering and artificial intelligence.

## Tech Stack
- Python, Flask, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker
- React, JavaScript, TypeScript, PWA
- Redis, JWT, Git, Linux

## Key Projects
- **OSP Logbook** — Flask + PostgreSQL + Docker + PWA web app for fire brigade unit logistics
- **AlkoRater** — iOS PWA for rating and cataloging alcohols
- **Gather** — FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Redis event/social REST API
- **UPM Ultras** — HTML/CSS static fan club website
